s: March 2, 2021 - Pretty Simple is a French independent video game developer and publisher headquartered in Paris, France. It develops and self-publishes free-to-play and casual games for social and mobile platforms. Co-founded in 2010 by Bastien Cazenave and Corentin Raux, Pretty Simple has published four games so far (My Shops in 2010, Magical Ride in 2011, Criminal Case in 2012, and Sorcery School in 2023), played by over 35 million monthly active users.
